name: Solecki

nadir.desc: The property consists of a primary residence with a gray roof and multiple attached and detached outbuildings|A large paved and gravel driveway provides parking space in front of the structures|Multiple vehicles and a recreational trailer are present in the driveway area|Open grassy areas, garden plots, and mature trees surround the buildings|Additional small sheds and covered structures are located in the rear and side portions of the lot.

alpha.desc: The front of the property shows the main residence and a detached garage or outbuilding facing the driveway|A paved and gravel parking area holds multiple vehicles and a trailer|Mature trees frame both sides of the approach|Open grassy areas extend around the structures.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the main residence and outbuildings set among mature trees with autumn foliage|Open grassy areas and garden plots are visible|Additional small structures and fencing appear in the rear portion of the lot.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows the back of the main residence with a covered patio or deck area|Open grassy lawn, garden beds, and small outbuildings or sheds are present|Mature trees and open space extend across the rear of the lot.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the main residence, detached garage, and driveway area|Multiple vehicles are parked in the open lot|Mature trees and landscaped plantings surround the structures|Open grassy areas continue toward the rear of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved and gravel driveway that leads from the road to a large parking area in front of the main residence and outbuildings. Multiple vehicles and a trailer occupy portions of the driveway. Open grassy areas around the structures provide space for emergency vehicle staging. Mature trees are present but do not fully enclose the buildings. The property has a rural layout with good overall access from the street.
